display.purpose: Mastheads, huge section words, and poster-scale signals.

headline.purpose: Project titles, section leads, and feature story headings.

body.purpose: Narrative copy, project descriptions, and personal statements.

label.purpose: Metadata, issue labels, links, chips, and timestamps.

shadows.name: Paper Lift
shadows.purpose: Large paper sections only when they need separation from the page ground.

shadows.name: Ink Plate Inset
shadows.purpose: Reversed black poster panels and dramatic masthead blocks.

shadows.name: Intro Paper Cast
shadows.purpose: The opening newspaper animation or a similarly physical paper moment.

motion.name: micro-lift
motion.value: transform 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease
motion.purpose: Small hover lift and ink inversion for links and buttons.

motion.name: section-reveal
motion.value: 0.7s ease forwards from opacity 0 and translateY(16px)
motion.purpose: Printed section entrance choreography. Disable for reduced motion.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Newspaper ticker and footer movement. Disable for reduced motion.

components.name: Editorial Link
components.description: A compact mono link for case files, records, and contact actions.
components.css: .ds-editorial-link { display: inline-block; color: #c0172d; font-family: IBM Plex Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #c0172d; padding-bottom: 0.1rem; transition: color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-editorial-link:hover { color: #17130f; border-bottom-color: #17130f; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-editorial-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e6f51; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Chip
components.description: A dense printed metadata chip for skills, issue labels, and small facts.
components.css: .ds-paper-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(54,44,33,0.46); background: rgba(246,239,226,0.76); color: #2b231b; padding: 0.16rem 0.54rem; border-radius: 1px; font-family: IBM Plex Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Ink Poster Panel
components.description: A high-impact reversed section block used for masthead moments and proof points.
components.css: .ds-ink-panel { display: grid; min-height: 12rem; place-items: center; background: #131313; color: #e7dfce; padding: 0.95rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(247,240,227,0.08), inset 0 0 138px rgba(0,0,0,0.76); } .ds-ink-word { margin: 0; font-family: Canopee, serif; font-size: clamp(4.2rem, 18.4vw, 12.7rem); line-height: 0.715; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Newspaper Feature Card
components.description: A ruled paper story block for projects and public records.
components.html:
SPECIAL FEATURE

Built production interfaces with a printmaker's eye

Dense, factual, and authored. The card reads like a clipping, not a SaaS tile.
components.css: .ds-feature-card { border: 1px solid rgba(45,36,24,0.72); background: rgba(255,248,233,0.82); color: #17130f; padding: 0.95rem; display: grid; gap: 0.62rem; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(23,19,15,0.08); } .ds-feature-label { margin: 0; color: #c0172d; font-family: IBM Plex Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-feature-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: Domaine Disp Cond Medium, serif; font-size: clamp(1.45rem,4.4vw,2rem); line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-feature-card p { margin: 0; font-family: PP Editorial New, serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.28; color: #1f1a15; }

components.name: Issue Navigation Tag
components.description: Small bordered navigation that wraps like newspaper issue tags.
components.css: .ds-issue-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.62rem; } .ds-issue-nav a { text-decoration: none; color: #342a1c; font-family: IBM Plex Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(45,36,24,0.72); padding: 0.32rem 0.56rem; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-issue-nav a:hover { background: #342a1c; color: #e7dfce; } .ds-issue-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e6f51; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: This system is a personal front page for a builder who wants taste to be visible. It uses newspaper language, article density, tactile paper, oversized type, ruled divisions, stamped labels, and project imagery to make the portfolio feel authored rather than assembled from a template. The visual posture is editorial, handcrafted, and distinctive. It should feel like a working desk covered with clippings, printed plates, proofs, and evidence of shipped work. It must still make the basics easy to find: identity, work, credibility, links, and contact.
keyCharacteristics: Newspaper grid with strong rules, dense type, and article-like project framing.
Warm aged paper fields with pressed ink and one sharp editorial red.
Oversized display type used as image and structure, not decoration.
Physical texture, inset darkness, and printed contrast instead of glossy app surfaces.
Motion is choreographed but respectful, with reduced-motion support preserved.

rules.name: The Red Is Editorial Rule
rules.body: Editorial Red is a mark, not a theme wash. Use it for labels, links, small symbols, and moments of emphasis, never as a broad gradient or generic accent flood.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: Never use #000 or pure white. Ink and paper must stay tinted, aged, and physical.

rules.name: The Type Is the Image Rule
rules.body: Large type is allowed to dominate a fold. If a section has no strong image, the typography must carry the visual weight with scale, rhythm, and contrast.

rules.name: The Mono Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: Mono is forbidden as a lazy developer costume. Use it only for labels, issue data, small navigation, and mechanical marks.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows must explain a physical object. If a shadow makes a panel feel like a SaaS dashboard card, remove it.

dos: Do make taste visible through type scale, texture, rules, and composition before relying on explanatory copy.
Do treat projects and roles as editorial evidence: feature stories, records, dispatches, clippings, and proofs.
Do use #17130f Pressed Ink instead of pure black and #DFD5CA or #C3BAB1 for aged paper surfaces.
Do keep Editorial Red rare and sharp. It is for editorial marks, not broad decoration.
Do preserve reduced-motion support for marquee, intro, reveal, and hover choreography.
donts: Don't make this feel like a generic developer portfolio.
Don't make this feel like a template resume site.
Don't make this feel like a SaaS landing page.
Don't make this feel like a polished but forgettable AI-startup page.
Don't copy another portfolio's surface treatment directly. The newspaper direction must feel owned by Satyam.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, nested app cards, or colored side-stripe borders.
Don't turn every section into identical icon, heading, text cards. Use editorial pacing and section-specific art direction.
